page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9a.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T25 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g9a.2xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for workloads that require steady CPU performance without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities. This profile is suited for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and moderate database hosting.
